description: Call this IMMEDIATELY before performing an approved action. Succeeds exactly once per request, only if the request is approved, not past its expiry, `action` is byte-for-byte the text that was approved, and operation/payload (if the request had them) are identical. ok:false for any reason means do NOT proceed. An approval cannot be reused for a second or different action. The returned JSON is not a transferable credential: no other component may accept it as proof of approval.

action.description: The exact action text you passed to request_approval

id.description: The request id returned by request_approval

operation.description: Optional operation name a trusted executor must present, e.g. 'smtp.send' (A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : / -)

payload.description: Optional JSON payload the action will execute (at most 32768 bytes canonical). The human reviews it; consume must present an identical payload.

name: consume_approval
